g.text: Issue 41 | Actual JLCPCB 3D placement preview, same board and supplier models
Bottom view. D4 and U4 both have PCB rotation 90° and native CAD Euler (0°,180°,270°).
Same calibrated supplier offsets in both uploads: diode C81598 = 0°; SOT-23 C916374 = 180°.
U4: two leads face lower side
U4: two leads meet upper pads
Gold rings: expected pad 1 from recorded Circuit JSON. Magenta markers are part of JLCPCB’s viewer.
Controls D3/U3 (PCB 0°): CSV 0°/180° in both uploads. Top controls are identical and aligned in both uploads.
Only D4/U4 angles differ between these two files. No manual component rotation, translation or auto-alignment.
Captured 2026-11-23. This verifies this preview fixture, not every supplier model or manufactured boards. No order/payment.
